description: This C# code-behind file is for the UserProfile page in an online examination system. It handles loading user data from a database based on session info, updating UI elements with user details, and navigation between different pages like dashboard, leaderboard, and login.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ASP.NET Web Form page managing user profile display and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; retrieves user info from database if session exists and populates the form; redirects to login if not logged in.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Intended to reload the user profile page (currently commented out).

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: coursesB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the taken courses page.
